subject: SET statement
notes: kb/Work PB455 + PB561 - LANDED, RE-MEASURED on the wave-42 worktree. GR7 has THREE sentences and all three are now witnessed. (1) THE STORE. `SET condition-name TO FALSE` places literal-4 'according to the rules for the VALUE clause' - the SAME recipe GR6 names, so SetEmitter.EmitSet selects `set.ToTrue ? cond.Values[0].Low : cond.FalseValue!` and hands it to DataEmitter.ValueImageOf -> ValueInitializer.InitializerFrom, one recipe with a selector rather than two stores (kb/Work PB560; ConditionValueRecipeDriftTests pins that the SET emitter spells no part of the recipe). Measured: `01 WF PIC X VALUE "Y". 88 WF-YES VALUE "Y" WHEN SET TO FALSE "N".` + `SET WF-YES TO FALSE` prints WF=N at --std 2023, where the row's own repro used to compile clean and then abort with NotImplementedCobolFeatureException after the program had already produced output. (2) THE GROUP-LENGTH EXCEPTION - 'when the conditional variable is an alphanumeric group item ... to which a table is subordinate, its length is determined as specified in 13.18.38' - is the group-image splice PlaceRenderer.WriteGroupImage already carries: measured on pb455_set_false_group_length, literal-4 "BBBB" into a group whose OCCURS 0 TO 4 DEPENDING ON is 2 stores "BB". (3) THE ZERO-LENGTH SENTENCE - 'If the length of the conditional variable is zero, the SET statement leaves it unchanged' - measured on the same program at DEPENDING ON = 0, on BOTH arms: the prior content survives. The COBOL-2002 introduction gate is recognition-fired (COBOL0900 at --std 85, pinned by conformance:cases/_unassigned/pb555-set-false-below-2002).
